newsitem.title: USA: BENCHMARQ names Derrell Coker chairman.
newsitem.headline: BENCHMARQ names Derrell Coker chairman.

text.p: BENCHMARQ Microelectronics Inc said Friday that its President and Chief Executive Derrell Coker will "transition to the role of chairman," while Al Schuele, formerly a vice president and general manager of Crystal Semiconductor, will become president and CEO.
This decision was prompted by what BENCHMARQ called its "desire to recruit leading industry executives to help the company exploit battery management and other mixed-signal IC opportunities."
The company said Coker will become chairman of the board and Schuele will assume the responsibilities of president and CEO on May 15.
